comment: et-3 seeded bugs, run on the committed tree: each mutant applied alone, lake build VE.Events.Examples run, then the five events files elaborated as one scratch file so every #guard runs even when an upstream proof fails (the listed tests are the #guard lines of lean/VE/Events/Examples.lean that fail); restored after each run. Harness: seeded-bugs-harness.py.txt.

mutants.claim: T2b needs the linear order premise (plan seeded bug 1)
mutants.replace: def orderPremises (V : EventsEnv) : List VE.Formula := [irreflexiveF V, transitiveF V, linearF V]
mutants.with: def orderPremises (V : EventsEnv) : List VE.Formula := [irreflexiveF V, transitiveF V]
test: #guard orderPremises vT1 == [irreflexiveF vT1, transitiveF vT1, linearF vT1]

mutants.claim: date facts are the consecutive pairs in calendar order (plan seeded bug 2)
mutants.replace: (consecutive V).map (fun p => ("events:date:" ++ isoPair p.1 p.2, dateFactF V p.1 p.2))
mutants.with:
((V.dates.flatMap fun a => V.dates.filterMap fun b => if b.num < a.num then some (a, b) else none).map
    (fun p => ("events:date:" ++ isoPair p.1 p.2, dateFactF V p.1 p.2)))
